questions.stem: Which of the following statement is True regarding acetazolamide?
questions.stemHtml: Which of the following statement is True regarding acetazolamide?

options.label: A
options.text: It is an irreversible inhibitor of carbonic anhydrase.

options.label: B
options.text: It shows the structural resemblance to sulfonamides.

options.label: C
options.text: It decreases potassium excretion through the nephron leading to hyperkalemia.
